items.note: Apartment 4B appears in the subject line and the body.
Says the heater "stopped working on October 2."
Says "I phoned you about it on October 3 and have not had a response."
Says "Overnight temperatures are now in the 40s." It leaves out °F, but the meaning is clear.
Asks for the heater to be "repaired within 48 hours of this email."
Says "Section 12 of my lease requires the landlord to provide heat."
The tone is polite and firm. It sets a clear deadline, cites the lease and asks for a reply, without being hostile.
It doesn't mention withholding rent at all.
It's about 80 words including the subject line, well under 150.
